digest.component_or_area: Jira DC outbound transport / status transition resolution
propositions: transition_issue_by_name matches the requested name against each transition's own name, but callers pass a destination status name, so the lookup misses when the two spellings differ.
On a classic Jira DC workflow the lookup miss raises ValueError, the applier soft-fails into bridge_alerts, and the pass exits 0 leaving the issue status unchanged.
The failure is a silent partial defect: statuses whose names coincide with transition names (e.g. Done) sync while others (e.g. in_progress -> In Progress) silently do not.
The bug was invisible on Cloud because that workflow names transitions after their destination statuses, so the two spellings coincide.

Remediation resolves a requested name against transition destination status (to.name) after an exact transition-name match, raising on ambiguous destinations and listing available transitions and their destinations in errors.
LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA must remain holding workflow state names, as it is shared with the inbound direction and config.local_to_jira_status.
